channel.title: Sofra Notes — Istanbul Restaurant Reviews
channel.description: A warm, honest field guide to eating in Istanbul — hidden gems and classics.

item.title: Çiya Sofrası — The Most Important Restaurant in Istanbul
item.description: Musa Dağdeviren's Kadıköy lokanta is not a restaurant so much as a living archive of Anatolian cooking. 9.1/10.

item.title: Karaköy Lokantası — A Modern Istanbul Classic
item.description: The turquoise-tiled lunchroom that still knows exactly what it is. 8.8/10.

item.title: Van Kahvaltı Evi — The Eastern Breakfast Benchmark
item.description: The Eastern Anatolian spread that reset the city's kahvaltı standard. 8.4/10.
